challenges.title: The National Living Wage, TUPE and many sites

items.title: Keeping the National Living Wage in sync
items.text: Since 1 April 2026, the National Living Wage has been £12.71 an hour — up from £12.21 since April 2025. Payroll has to apply these rates consistently across every site.

items.title: TUPE transfers when providers change
items.text: When a cleaning contract changes provider (a service provision change), the transferring cleaners' terms and conditions — including contractual working hours and rotas — pass automatically to the new employer. TUPE 2006 requires a seamless transfer.

items.title: Many sites, changing teams
items.text: Every site has its own hours and requirements, and teams change frequently — keeping track of it all by hand is barely feasible.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off cleaning services in the UK
solutions.subtitle: From optimised routes to traceable TUPE documentation — everything works together.

items.title: Site routes optimised
items.text: Klacks sequences sites so that journeys stay short — by car, bike or on foot.

items.title: Hours for payroll
items.text: Klacks records the hours worked at each site and provides them as a file export for your payroll — you apply the National Living Wage of £12.71 an hour in your payroll software.

items.title: TUPE transfers cleanly documented
items.text: You record transferring cleaners in Klacks along with their existing rotas and terms and conditions — the basis for documenting TUPE transfers in a traceable way.

items.title: Teams scheduled flexibly
items.text: Changing rosters, casual staff and holiday: Klacks keeps track of it all and suggests suitable assignments.

items.title: Qualifications matched
items.text: Specialist cleaning, machinery, secure areas: only appropriately qualified staff are ever scheduled.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: "Schedule the city-centre sites for tomorrow morning" is all it takes — Klacksy starts the planning, Klacks optimises the route and team allocation.

example.title: Provider change, one plan
example.text: When your business takes on a cleaning contract under TUPE, you record the transferring cleaners' existing rotas in Klacks and carry on planning them seamlessly — no manual recalculating required.
